I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. 

The audit evaluated data freshness, data quality, navigation, UX, and the mobile experience across the home feed, category pages (Weather, Economics), and Championship grids. 

I've attached the detailed final report along with key screenshots highlighting the critical findings and what works well. 

The most critical issues identified include:
1. Future scheduled MLB games incorrectly appearing in the "Just Happened" section marked as "FINAL" with 0-0 scores.
2. Unresolved events and live games showing exactly 100%/0% probabilities.
3. Incomplete NBA and NHL championship grids missing teams and columns.

Please review the attached `bainluck_audit_report.md` for the full breakdown and suggested improvements.
